Trigger.Name: PRE-TEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
:ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;
 select chapter_name
 into :s_chapter_name
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
exception
 when no_data_found then
 :s_chapter_name := null;
 when others then
 null;
 end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 v_local_date date;
 
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 
 select distinct coll_date
 into :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 from units
 where nursing_audit_status is null
 and coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date;
 
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message(sqlerrm); pause;
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled 
 then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_date);
 end if;
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date > v_local_date
 then
 show_error('0060');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if :GLOBAL.unit_form_checkin_flag = 'Y'
 then
 begin
 update units
 set nursing_audit_flag = 'Y',
 nursing_audit_status =
 :ctrl_blk_1.nursing_audit_status,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 if form_success
 then
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 down;
 end if;
end;

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_COLL_DATE_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select distinct coll_date ,
 to_char(coll_date,'DD-MON-YYYY') col_date 
from units 
where coll_date is not null 
and coll_date between trunc(to_date(to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.ctrl_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi'),'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi'))-21 
and trunc(to_date(to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.ctrl_local_date,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi'),'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi'))
and nursing_audit_status is null order by coll_date desc
